title: 검사복무평정규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:5:2:00006:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 5-2 (Evaluation Meetings)
(1) To ensure fair and reasonable service evaluations of prosecutors, district prosecutors' offices and branch offices of district prosecutors' offices with a deputy chief prosecutor under Article 23 (1) of the Act shall hold an evaluation meeting before service evaluators conduct service evaluations.
(2) The deputy chief prosecutor and chief prosecutors of divisions of the relevant district prosecutors' office or branch office shall participate in the evaluation meeting and collect opinions on service evaluations of all prosecutors subject to evaluation concerning the respective items under Article 4.
(3) Discussions at evaluation meetings shall not be disclosed externally.
